subject: Invoice routing & VAT evidence for initial run
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <accounts@aurora-med.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice routing and VAT evidence for Nov run

Hi Markus,

We're getting ready for the November invoice run and want to confirm how Redwood will send invoices and what VAT evidence you need from us. Our AP team prefers to receive invoices through a portal push (peppol or SFTP) for automation, but they'd like a one-time PDF copy via email for the first cycle while the portal handoff is completed.

Can you confirm: 
- Whether you can push to a portal collector or SFTP (we can provide host/credentials)
- The exact billing contact/email you need on the PDF copy
- What VAT evidence you require (certificate, registration ID format, country-specific doc)
- Any PO/PO-number fields we should include to map to your invoice metadata (we will supply PO #: AUR-PO-9921)

I've attached our VAT certificate (aurora_vat_cert.pdf). If you need an AP contact to coordinate the portal technicals, please let me know and I'll loop them in.

Thanks,
Dana Lopez
AP Manager, Aurora Medical Systems
accounts@aurora-med.com
Attachment: aurora_vat_cert.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lopez <accounts@aurora-med.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice routing and VAT evidence for Nov run

Hi Dana —

Thanks for the VAT cert and the heads-up on PO AUR-PO-9921. Short answers up front and a suggested path: 

1) Delivery options we support: portal push (preferred), SFTP push, or emailed PDF copies. Portal push is the most reliable for AP automation; we can push in UBL/XML or PDF+XML wrapper depending on collector.

2) For the emailed PDF fallback, please send to billing@redwood.com and include CC to the billing contact below so our finance team picks it up automatically. For the one-off first-cycle email, include the PO and VAT ID on the PDF header.

3) VAT evidence: the cert you attached is fine. We need the registration number printed on vendor letterhead (you have that covered). Country-specific note: if you have multiple EU entities please include the invoice-level VAT flag and the entity VAT number you want Redwood to bill.

4) Mapping/metadata: please include PO number in the invoice meta (PO: AUR-PO-9921). If you want line-level cost center mapping, send us the sample mapping file.

Operational proposal (what I'd recommend we do this week):
- Marissa will lead the portal handoff and collect the collector URL/credentials.
- Karthik will confirm our e-invoice format (UBL vs hybrid) and the XML sample we expect.
- For the Nov run we'll send you a staged invoice by email to the billing address you provide, and simultaneously begin portal onboarding so future cycles go via portal.

I've attached a staged invoice sample (staged-invoice-sample.pdf) so you can confirm layout and PO fields. Can you confirm the exact email to receive the one-off PDF and the AP contact for portal setup?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: staged-invoice-sample.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

- I'll own the portal collector onboarding and will request the collector URL + supported payload (UBL/XML or PDF+XML).
- Karthik, can you paste the minimal XML schema and our preferred field names (PO, invoice_ref, vat_number) so I can pass them to Aurora's AP team?
- I'll request a test push and confirm success before the December run; for Nov we'll proceed with email PDF.

Marking billing@redwood.com as the invoice receiver is fine — confirm that AP wants copies to ap@aurora-med.com as well.

I'll follow up with a short onboarding checklist and a timeboxed window for the test push.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Hi Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. We will: 
- Confirm AP email: ap@aurora-med.com (please send the one-off Nov PDF to ap@aurora-med.com and cc billing@redwood.com so our internal system picks it up)
- Provide collector details by Wednesday (we use a private SFTP collector but can accept UBL if your E-invoice collector supports it)
